svg.title: Sky grids in landscape and portrait with two projections
svg.desc: Four panels compare rectilinear and stereographic projections at 75 degrees vertical field of view, looking north at elevation 20 degrees. Stereographic curves the off-center horizon and changes peripheral grid spacing. Portrait panels show less horizontal sky.
svg.text: The same sky on desktop and phone
Looking north, 20° above the horizon · All panels: 75° vertical FOV
Teal: horizon · Gray: 15° grid · Colored dots: identical sample directions
Equal vertical coverage is not equal horizontal coverage. Dots are illustrative, not live satellites.
